bot.name: Legion-OSINT
bot.description: Private Bangladesh-priority global public-source OSINT assistant

commands.code:
# Set your Telegram numeric user ID after using /myid.
OWNER_IDS = []
FEED_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fyroz118/Legion-OSINT/main/docs/feed/latest.json"
bot.sendMessage("Your Telegram user ID: " + str(u) + "\nAdd this number to OWNER_IDS in the .env command, save it, then use /start.")

if str(u) in [str(x) for x in OWNER_IDS] and message.chat.type == "private":
    bot.sendMessage("/status — collection freshness and counts
/daily — latest public Telegram posts
/bangladesh — Bangladesh posts
/search <terms> — search the current feed
/leads — recent source leads
/briefs — individual source briefs
/coverage — channel collection diagnostics
/report — evidence digest (not a verified incident report)
/reviewqueue — unreviewed source posts
/reviewlead ID | reviewed|rejected|duplicate | source_class
/candidates — recent event-news leads for analyst screening
/incidentdraft POST_ID | INCIDENT_ID | COUNTRY | CATEGORY | DESCRIPTION
/incidentqueue — incident drafts and inclusion status
/approveincident INCIDENT_ID | approved|rejected | rationale
/linklead POST_ID | INCIDENT_ID | lead|corroboration|contradiction
/alerts_on — enable two-hourly alerts
/alerts_off — disable alerts
/ask and /research — not connected yet

Source integrity: posts remain UNVERIFIED; publication time is not incident time; reposts are not independent corroboration. Approval permits report inclusion only and does not verify an event.")
else:
    bot.sendMessage("Access denied. Legion-OSINT is restricted to its owner in private chat.")

export_info.note: Import commands into the existing TBC bot only after reviewing .env. This package does not include or modify Telegram credentials.
